text: Parece ser um bom app, mas se preciso cadastrar meu cartão de crédito não deveria ser considerado gratuito...
author: Mariane Queiroz - Casa das Frô
developer_reply: It's Martyna here, co-founder of Unique. I’m sorry for the confusion. Unique has many free features, including the planner, mood tracker, affirmations, and tests. Premium is optional and helps us continue building the app. If this clarifies things, we’d be grateful if you updated your review to more stars. It helps other ADHDers discover the app.

text: Esse app é realmente muito bom, ele tem me ajudado bastante a manter minhas pequenas tarefas em dia; pra quem tem TDAH, essas pequenas coisas podem ser grandes desafios. Porém, estou enfrentando um problema com as meditações, que é o fato que quando ela termina de gerar, apesar de eu clicar o play, eu não consigo escutar o áudio gerado :( além disso, o anúncio pedindo pra comprar o Premium toda vez que entro no app é meio chato, podiam fazer aparecer menos vezes.
author: beau
developer_reply: Hi, Martyna here, co-founder of Unique. Thank you so much for your kind words! Could you write to us at contact@univi.app? We’d love to investigate the meditation audio issue, but we need your account email to find it on our end.

text: Thank you for your attention!!!! It's great that it became a tool, but it would be nice if, in addition to became a tool, it generate a task too
author: Johnny L
developer_reply:
Hi Johnny! After completing an assignment in the “Learn” tab, you collect a tool — it appears in your profile so you can come back to it anytime! ✨
If you find Univi helpful, we’d be super grateful if you could update your rating to 5⭐ — it really helps us grow! And feel free to reach us at contact@univi.app or on Instagram @univi_adhd

text: Love this app! How great and simple to learn and retain the knowledge!
author: carla menta
developer_reply:
Hi Carla! 😊
Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re thrilled to hear you find Univi helpful and easy to use. If you have any feedback or questions, feel free to reach out at contact@univi.app. And if you’re enjoying the app, we’d love it if you recommended us to your friends! 💜🐙

text: amei, mas tem muita coisa paga
author: nathy.
developer_reply:
Hi Matt,

Thanks for your review! We’re glad you loved the app! We offer many free features, but to keep Univi running and improving, we rely on users who choose to support us with the premium version.

If you have any suggestions on what you’d like to see in the free version, let us know at contact@univi.app we’d love to hear your feedback!

text: Parecia muito bom, mas é pago. Assim que você baixa, vc recebe uma semana gratuita e depois é pagamento contínuo por ano ou mês
author: eluryun
developer_reply: Dear eluryun. I’m Mateusz, co-founder of Univi. We're an ADHD-friendly app, and your experience is crucial for us. If you'd like a refund, please contact me at contact@univi.app, and I'll assist you. It’s crucial for us that you consider removing this review, as it impacts our app significantly. Your understanding and support mean a lot to us.

author: Mel Diverse Me
developer_reply: Hi Mel :) Thank you for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you're having an amazing experience with our app. Please recommend the Univi ADHD app to your friends. It will help us grow. Thank you <3 Hugs, Martyna, Univi co-founder and your ADHD friend

text: A app parece-me limitada a meia dúzia de estratégias, apesar de muito interessantes. No entanto tomem atenção, pois se não controlam o tempo do free trial, eles não avisam e cobram imediatamente!
author: Rita Gaspar
developer_reply: Hi Rita, We are transparent, after the 7-day free trial, a charge will apply. We’re committed to being an ADHD-friendly app; if someone misses the deadline and reaches out to us at contact@univi.app, we’re more than happy to issue a refund. If you could kindly leave us a 5-star review, it would mean a lot to us and help our app grow. Thank you! 🌟

text: Pox preciso muito do app pensaria em investir também. Porém não está em português Brasil. Uma pena.
author: Gleidson
developer_reply:
Thank you for your feedback! I'm Martyna Univi, co-founder of the app and your ADHD friend. We understand the importance of having Brazilian Portuguese available. If you could please change your rating, it would greatly help us grow and increase our chances of adding new languages sooner.
Thanks again for your support! ♥️

author: Manassés Eliézer da Rocha
developer_reply: Hey :) We are pleased that you enjoyed the app. If there is anything we can do for you, just let us know at contact@univi.app!

text: É muito bom e dá dicas muito úteis. A grande maioria das estratégias que ví em redes sociais não funcionaram, mas as estratégias desse app FUNCIONAM pra mim e têm feito uma boa diferença. Mas apesar disso, o app tem alguns defeitos: Dentre eles o fato de é tudo em inglês. Não tem tradução nem legenda em português. Além disso você tem que fazer uma redaçãozinha ao final de cada lição, o que pode ser meio chato. Ainda assim o app é muito bom e vale a pena.
author: Mari Melo
developer_reply: Hi Mari, nice to have you here in our ADHD tribe :) Thank you for providing your valuable feedback. Currently, the app is in English, but if we gain many users, we will work on translating Univi into other languages :) If you have any ideas on how we can improve this little essay for the assignment, please reach out to us at contact@univi.app.

text: Esse é um dos melhores apps pra TDAH que eu já conheci na vida. Ele me ajuda mais do que os anos de terapia que eu fiz. Proporciona ferramentas práticas pro dia a dia, de uma maneira simples, interativa, fácil. A meditação personalizada é incrível. As histórias, a abordagem, o método. Eu sou só gratidão por esse aplicativo. Muito muito obrigada. Vocês me deram muito mais do que dicas. Vocês me deram ferramentas pra ter controle sobre meu transtorno. Tem mudado minha vida. Obrigada obrigada
author: Carla Menta
developer_reply: Carla, your message deeply touches all of us at Univi. Knowing our combination of ADHD-focused content, meditations, and CBT-tools has had such a significant impact on your life fills us with gratitude and motivation. We're immensely thankful for your presence in our community and for sharing how profoundly Univi has changed your journey.

text: Queria tanto poder usar o app, mas tá em inglês e não consegui mudar o idioma (provavelmente não tem português). Poxa, o app parece tão organizado, mas tive que desinstalar antes de nem ter usado.
author: ɢᴀʙʀɪᴇʟᴇ
developer_reply: It’s Mateusz, co-founder or Univi. As a small, free app, our resources for additional languages like Portuguese are limited. Lower ratings impact our visibility and ability to help more ADHDers. If you could reconsider your rating, it would greatly support our mission to reach and assist more individuals. Thank you for your understanding.
